name: station-left-g20-v2
notes: Supersedes station-left-g20-v1: only the table and the gamepad placeholder height changed.

table is the 15 mm top plate of workstation_table.STL in AR5_L25_workstation.urdf (design CAD, not measured): x 0.0934-0.7184, y 0.0002-1.2502, z 0.7522-0.7672 in world; the frame below the plate is omitted.
Unresolved discrepancy: by the URDF the left base mesh bottom (z 1.2105) is 0.443 m above the table top, while ~/Gzl/bottle-cap-opening/AI_HANDOFF.md records a user-measured 0.500 m.
left_arm.base_pose is the AR5 URDF design value; no base calibration exists on the station.
left_arm.home_q is an all-zero placeholder and is not a verified collision-free home pose.
left_hand.mount is the station L25 fixed-joint transform and is unverified for G20; the Rokae controller toolset is zero.

gamepad.root_pose is a placeholder: face up in front of the left base (y 0.715), collision bottom (-0.0299 m in controller_body) about 1 mm above the table top; x/y await left-arm IK against the reach placements.
